title: Online Majority Element In Subarray
description: Find the majority element (appears > threshold times) in a subarray using a dictionary of indices and binary search.
pseudocode:
1. map = {val: [sorted_indices]}
2. low = bisect_left(map[val], left)
3. high = bisect_right(map[val], right)
4. count = high - low
5. if count >= threshold return val

steps.note: Query range [0, 2], threshold 2. Search for value 1 in map.
Find first index of 1 >= 0 (index 0) and last index of 1 <= 2 (index 2).
